issues.description: The data type of StockIngredient.price is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement UML specifies price as int (StockIngredient -price: int), the template implementation defines price as double (constructor StockIngredient(String, double, int) and getPrice(): double), while the solution uses int for price. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected type and constructor signature and may lead to incorrect implementations or test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the StockIngredient.price type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably update the template StockIngredient to use an int for price (change the field type, constructor parameter, and getPrice() return type to int) to match the UML in problem_statement.md and the solution. Alternatively, if fractional prices are intended, update the problem statement and solution to document and use double consistently.
